decision_summary: Approve QIF v0.6.26 Calibration Readiness CLI as the next release slice.
rationale: Visionary: Phase 4 needs an honest entry gate before calibration numbers can acquire meaning. Builder: implement a read-only composition over existing ledger, calibration, pilot-corpus, and roadmap evidence; do not add a package type. Guardian: default committed examples to example-only evidence, require explicit observed evidence before empirical-ready status, and keep semantic truth, predictive validity, and release approval outside the command's claims.
recommendation: Implement calibration-readiness, tests, docs, release notes, and AOF evidence; release only after QIF and AOF verification.
